scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @squad/schemas && npm run build -w @squad/codex-client && npm run build -w @squad/runner && npm run build -w @squad/agents && npm run build -w @squad/event-store && npm run build -w @squad/github-issues && npm run build -w @squad/orchestrator
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @squad/api && npm run build -w @squad/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
